basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Wellington, New Zealand. I've recently dived into the world of PC building and gaming, and I love exploring new hardware setups. When I'm not tinkering with my PC, you'll find me writing short stories or enjoying a relaxing sauna session. I work as a junior web developer, which keeps me busy during the weekdays. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings online, usually between 6 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a self-taught tech enthusiast who started building PCs about 6 months ago. My knowledge mainly comes from online tutorials, forums, and trial-and-error experiences. While I don't have formal training, my background in web development gives me a solid understanding of technology and problem-solving.
